name: @fuaran-ui/spec-hash
description: Reference implementation of the canonical-json-sha256-v1 minting canonicalisation — recursive ordinal member ordering, ECMAScript number serialisation, and the sha256:{hex} content address minted over the resulting bytes. Workspace-internal: it gates this tier against the specification's own corpus and against an independent implementation of the same registered rule, and is deliberately not published.
author: Andrew J. Willshire <andrew@fuaran.com> (Diametrical Ltd)
